definitions.explanation: An ingredient, mix, or concentrate that serves as the base for making something else. Especially common in food product names like だしの{素|もと} (dashi base) or ラーメンの{素|もと} (ramen base).

examples.japanese: だし⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{素|もと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
⟦お{好|この}み{焼|や}き→お好み焼き：10252_okonomiyaki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{素|もと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}って→買う：00489_kau⟧きた。

⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{素|もと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}えば→使う：00473_tsukau⟧、⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{本格的|ほんかくてき}→本格的：05681_honkakuteki⟧な⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{楽|たの}しめる→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
examples.english: If you use a hot-pot base, you can easily enjoy an authentic taste at home.

notes:
{素|もと} as a base/mix is almost always written with the kanji {素|もと} and attaches with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ to the name of the dish: {dish}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{素|もと} = "{dish} base." Often sold as a powder, paste, or concentrate.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- だし⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{素|もと}: dashi base
- ⟦お{好|この}み{焼|や}き→お好み焼き：10252_okonomiyaki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{素|もと}: okonomiyaki mix
- ⟦カレー→カレー：02898_karee⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{素|もと}: curry base/mix
- ⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{素|もと}: hot-pot base
- ⟦{唐揚|からあ}げ→唐揚げ：04949_karaage⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{素|もと}: karaage seasoning mix

WATCH OUT:
- ⟦{元|もと}→元：03878_moto⟧: origin; former — different kanji, different meaning
- {基|もと}: basis, foundation — abstract grounding (⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{基|もと}づく→基づく：02315_motozuku⟧)
